name: savvy-progress
description: A row under each Agent and Workflow call with an activity strip (a tick per tool call, colored as tool-borders colors it), a roll call of crabs in the band above the prompt while agents work, and an agents panel (/agents-info): each subagent's model, tool calls by kind, last actions as they stream, files touched, answer, cost and time; failed agents pinned, stopped and overdue ones marked; a strip of crabs grouped by status, named and wearing their model's color, on top.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

stepReports.title: Step reports from subagents
stepReports.description: Ask every subagent to report its steps, for a real progress bar per agent. Turn off when accuracy matters more than the bar: subagents are no longer asked and show their context fill instead.
